test_title: PYST 3: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 1 )
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

1. All apples are mangoes.

2. Some bananas are mangoes.

Conclusions:

I. Some mangoes are bananas.

II. Some mangoes are apples.

III. No mango is an apple.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions I and III follow
Either conclusion I or III follows

solution:
From the given statements, the Venn diagram is:

1. All apples are mangoes.

2. Some bananas are mangoes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97ae38facfd22aa81b769b727a4cf696c15560786ac3f9dbbd0836647c2e3646.png] 

**__Conclusion:__**

I. Some mangoes are bananas → Follow → As&am
